why: 0.5° averages the Nile valley with desert: villages got no fields

decision: farmed area = cell cropland x group's share of cell people, packed round the village, max 2 km; floor 0.5 ha per villager
why: HYDE early cropland 1-2 % of a 5' cell; crop x 2 km disk drew nothing; many early cells are farmer by head count with ~0 cropland (SETTLED_MIN_CELL)
evidence: poetry PIL read of landuse_-3000/100 at Memphis and Rome

decision: drape pieces sit on the highest corner of the ground cell under them
why: pieces on their own grid cut under ground folds (holes)

decision: grazed washes painted into ground vertex colours, drawn as a second copy of the ground mesh, not a translucent overlay mesh
why: overlay washes z-fought and showed holes; swapping the ground mesh prop did not reliably redraw; a copy on identical vertices wins less-equal

decision: drape cache key is a version per new patch set, not the view box key
why: patches can change for the same view box (grid arrives, morph rebuilt): stale drapes

decision: per-site cache keyed by inputs and neighbours; claims only within twice the farmed reach; one hash per corner/strip; one shade per patch; one-cell pieces
why: Rome-like input: generation 424 -> ~100 ms cold / 10 ms cached, dense-tile drape 312 -> ~20 ms (jest)
